items.heading: Pick the Specialisation, Not Just
items.text: Pick the Specialisation, Not Just Pick the specialisation, not just the institute name. Thermal, design, manufacturing, or the newer mechatronics/robotics-leaning M.Tech tracks lead to different job markets. A vague "M.Tech Mechanical" without a chosen depth area competes worse than a sharp specialisation.

items.heading: Decide the Actual Reason First
items.text: Decide the actual reason first. A stronger step score for a better PSU rank, a specific research specialisation, or a documented target company that only hires postgraduates for a role you want. "Placements felt weak" is not a reason by itself.

items.heading: Check the Step Score Band
items.text: Check the step score band for your target IIT/NIT honestly. IIT M.Tech admission runs on step score plus category and often a written test or interview at the specific institute. A borderline score into a lower-ranked program is a different bet than a strong score into a top-tier lab.

items.heading: Compare Against the Step
items.text: Compare against the step-PSU alternative before committing two years. The same step score that gets you into a mid-tier M.Tech program might also qualify you for PSU shortlisting. Run the actual number against both doors before assuming the degree is the safer choice.
